The recorded gate receipt is stale: it names revision 816fdec78 and 'checks run: 12', while the head checker runs 24 checks, and manifest.md:11 records no test_logs path. The head result survives only in the manifest's checkpoint sentence. The '11 of 11' documentation denominator is the literal ROOTS list of eleven control codes rather than a live count, so a later first-level node would leave the measure silently reporting 11 of 11. The graph read control_node_one does return 11 today, and the record states the measure as a lower bound, so the figure is right now and only the guard against drift is missing.
